November 2, 41.
1.

Functioning of members of Income Tax
Collecting Bureau of Ministry of Finance
(Wang Ching Wei Government) in Hongkew District

At 2 p.m. on the 1/11/41, Kying Tseng Zee
(金正泉), proprietor of a butcher's shop, No.125,
Woosung Road, reported at the station the following
facts:-
On the 28/10/41, three male Chinese entered
his shop and produced identification cards with photos
attached and they stated they were members of the "Income
Tax Collecting Bureau of the Ministry of Finance (Wang
Ching Wei Government)" and that they desired to inspect
his account books relative to his income for the year
1940.
After they had examined the accounts the
informant was told by the "collectors" that according
to his accounts books he would be compelled to pay the
sum of $6000.00 tax on his 1940 income, representing
approx. 10%.
They produced income tax notification forms
in duplicate and explained that they did not collect
any cash themselves and they only assessed the amounts.
The assessed tax monies were to be paid into
the Central Reserve Bank on or before the 30/10/41.

汪精卫政府财政部
所得税征收局成员在虹口区
的活动情况

1941年11月1日下午2时，吴淞路125号肉铺店主金正泉（Kying Tseng Zee）向警局报告了以下事实：-
1941年10月28日，三名中国男子进入其店铺，出示了贴有照片的身份证，并声称他们是“汪精卫政府财政部所得税征收局”的成员，希望检查他关于1940年收入的账簿。
在检查账目后，举报人被告知，根据他的账簿，他将被迫缴纳1940年收入的税款6000.00元，约占10%。
他们出示了一式两份的所得税通知单，并解释说他们自己不收取任何现金，只负责核定金额。
核定的税款须在1941年10月30日或之前存入中央储备银行。

（批：S! / 1941年11月3日）

（批：R.S./10）

However, they suggested to the informant
that for a "consideration" of $2000.00 paid to them
in cash, they would assess his 1940 income tax at
$3000.00, thereby saving him the sum of $1000.00.

The informant agreed but demanded a receipt
for the $2000.00 from the collectors, who refused to
give any receipt whatsoever, and left the premises.

At 10 a.m. on the 1/11/41, they returned to
the informant's shop and re-iterated their former
statement. The informant, however, refused to give the
$2000.00 without obtaining a receipt for the amount
and the three "tax collectors" then left his shop
stating that they would again return on the 2/11/41.

The informant stated to Police that he
intended to pay the tax as he realised that owing to
the present political situation it would be to his
disadvantage if he refused and that he did not desire
any Police action.

D.S.I. Fedoroff and C.D.S.222 disclosed that since the

1941年11月1日上午10时，他们回到举报人的店铺，重申了之前的说法。然而，举报人拒绝在未获得金额收据的情况下支付2000.00元，随后这三名“税务征收员”离开了他的店铺，并表示将于1941年11月2日再次回来。

- activities.

The Shanghai Collection Office of the Income Tax
Bureau attached to the Ministry of Finance of the Nanking
Government, Lane 668, House 121 Yu Yuen Road, C.C.L., has

a number of concerns in the Settlement in respect of the

conditions have been filled in. It is reported that the
distribution was made in accordance with a list seized
from the former Chinese Chamber of Commerce containing
names of those concerns which are alleged to have paid

Income Tax Bureau of the Ministry of Finance
of the Nanking Government - Activities.

The Shanghai Collection Office of the Income Tax
Bureau attached to the Ministry of Finance of the Nanking
Government, Lane 668, House 121 Yu Yuen Road, O.O.L.,
continues its activities in the extra-Settlement roads
area of the Western District. According to this bureau,
a number of Chinese industrial concerns and commercial
firms in the Western District, O.O.L. have complied with
its instructions by submitting reports on their business
conditions to the Western District Branch of the Shanghai
Collection Office of the Income Tax Bureau, as a preliminary
step towards the payment of duty.

For the sake of convenience of its members, the
Connaught Road Branch of the Western District Citizens'
Association, 351 Connaught Road, has formed an "Income
Tax Information Agency" (所得稅陳報代辦所 ) at House 17
Yung Woo Tseng (永和邨 ), Connaught Road, O.O.L. Those
who are reluctant to make contact with the Income Tax
Bureau may apply to the Agency for service pertaining to
reports on their business conditions and payment of
income tax. Handbills announcing the establishment of
the Agency were distributed in the Western District, O.O.L.
on August 5, a copy of which is attached hereto.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 8 AUG. 1941）

南京政府财政部所得税局 - 活动情况。

南京政府财政部所属所得税局上海征收处（位于西区越界筑路区域霞飞路668弄121号）继续在西区越界筑路区域开展活动。据该局称，西区越界筑路区域的一些中国工业企业和商业公司已遵照其指示，向所得税局上海征收处西区分处提交经营状况报告，作为缴纳税款的第一步。

为方便其成员，康纳路市民协会康纳路分处（康纳路351号）已在西区越界筑路区域康纳路永和邨17号成立了一个“所得税陈报代办所”。那些不愿与所得税局直接接触的人，可向该代办所申请有关经营状况报告和缴纳所得税的服务。宣布该代办所成立的传单于8月5日在西区越界筑路区域分发，副本附后。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1941年8月8日）

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL.
August 4, 1941.
Income Tax Office of the Ministry
of Finance of the Nanking Government.
Between July 21 and 23, 1941, leading business firms,
factories and shops etc. located in the French Concession
received through the post a notification from the Income
Tax Office of the Ministry of Finance of the Nanking
Government, No. 121, Lane 565 Yu Yuen Road, instructing them
to pay before the end of September an income tax on the
profits accrued during 1940. The notification further
states that defaulters will be fined from two to five
times the tax required. As far as can be ascertained,
none of the recipients of the notification have paid the
tax.
Should there be no response within the time limit,
the Tax Office is reported to be prepared to grant an
extension, in which case efforts will be made to reach
an understanding with the various trade associations
through the French Concession Chinese Ratepayers Association
of the Wang Ching Wei clique. The Income Tax Office
is rather optimistic regarding collection in the French
Concession on the grounds that it will have the support
of the Chinese Ratepayers Association and the Chinese
Courts in the French Concession.
（批：bhr）

南京政府财政部
所得税局。
1941年7月21日至23日期间，位于法租界的主要商行、工厂和商店等通过邮政收到了来自南京政府财政部所得税局（霞飞路565弄121号）的通知，指示他们在9月底前缴纳1940年所得利润的所得税。通知还指出，逾期不缴者将被处以应纳税额两至五倍的罚款。据查，收到通知的人中无人缴纳税款。
据报道，如果在限期内没有回应，税务局准备给予延期，在这种情况下，将通过汪精卫派系的法租界华人纳税会努力与各同业公会达成谅解。所得税局对法租界的征收工作相当乐观，理由是它将得到法租界华人纳税会和法租界中国法院的支持。
（批：bhr）

S.1, Special Branch
July 3, 1941.

Income Tax Bureau of the Ministry of
Finance of the Nanking Government -
Activities.
--------------------------------------

The Shanghai Collection Office of the Income
Tax Bureau attached to the Ministry of Finance of the
Nanking Government, Lane 668, House 121 Yu Yuen Road,
commenced functioning on July 1, 1941. Under this
office are the "Western District Section" (滬西區辦事處)
which is also located at Lane 668, House 121 Yu Yuen
Road, and the "Hongkew District Section" (虹口區辦事處),
situated at House 22 North Szechuen Li, North Szechuen
Road. The former is in charge of one KUH CHING FOO
( 葛敬孚 ), and the latter, one WONG YUAN ( 黃元 )
alias WONG CHI HUAN ( 黃智垣 ).

On July 1, the Shanghai Collection Office of
the Income Tax Bureau distributed, through the post,
copies of a circular notice to the various Chinese
business firms and industrial concerns in the Western
District, O.O.L. The notice states that in accordance
with an order issued by the National Government
(Nanking Government) on May 14, 1941, the Bureau in
question will levy income tax on the profits of
business enterprises and on earnings secured by means
of debentures and bonds as well as on bank deposits.
The collection will be retroactive from the year 1940.
Those concerned are required to submit reports to the
Shanghai Collection Office of the Income Tax Bureau
in respect of business conditions, gains and profits
within a period of twenty days, as from the date of
receipt of the circular notice; and pay due tax between

1941年7月3日。

南京政府财政部
所得税局 -
活动。
--------------------------------------

隶属于南京政府财政部的所得税局上海征收处，位于愚园路668弄121号，于1941年7月1日开始运作。该处下设“沪西区办事处”（滬西區辦事處），同样位于愚园路668弄121号；以及“虹口区办事处”（虹口區辦事處），位于北四川路北四川里22号。前者由葛敬孚（KUH CHING FOO）负责，后者由黄元（WONG YUAN）负责，又名黄智垣（WONG CHI HUAN）。

7月1日，所得税局上海征收处通过邮政向越界筑路区西区（Western District, O.O.L.）的各华商企业和工业机构分发了通告副本。通告指出，根据国民政府（南京政府）于1941年5月14日发布的命令，该局将对企业利润、通过 debentures（公司债）和 bonds（债券）获得的收益以及银行存款征收所得税。征收将追溯至1940年。有关方面须在收到通告之日起二十天内，向所得税局上海征收处提交关于经营状况、收益和利润的报告；并在

July 1 and September 30, 1941. Any one failing to
report within the specified period, or making false
reports and/or refusing to pay the income tax will
be subject to a minimum fine of $20.00 in addition
to which imprisonment for not more than one year may
be imposed.

An official notice has been prepared for posting
in the Western District, O.O.L. to inform the public
of the establishment of the Shanghai Collection Office
of the Income Tax Bureau and the levy of the tax.
It is learned that the Office in question will
endeavour to start functioning in the Settlement in
September, 1941.

Attached are specimen of the circular notice
and various blank forms regarding the collection of

已准备一份官方公告，张贴于越界筑路区西区（O.O.L.），以告知公众所得税局上海征收处的成立及征税事宜。据悉，该处将努力于1941年9月在租界内开始运作。
